statement: In federal civil litigation a defendant must serve an answer within 21 days after being served with the summons and complaint (FRCP 12(a)(1)(A)(i)); a defendant that timely waived service under Rule 4(d) has 60 days after the waiver request was sent (90 days if it was sent outside any judicial district of the United States).
caveat: State courts set their own answer deadlines — the summons states the controlling one. Rule 12 motions alter the response time, the United States and its officers have 60 days, and local rules and orders can modify everything. This repo does not calculate or extend any deadline.
